title: vincetoxicum hirundinaria subsp. luteolum
intro: Vincetoxicum hirundinaria subsp. luteolum, commonly known as Yellow Swallow-wort or Yellow Perennial Milkweed, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Vincetoxicum hirundinaria subsp. luteolum include immunomodulatory and vasodilatory effects, which may help in regulating the immune system and improving blood flow. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardenolides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
